methods.pairing: Exact UTC join; complete local-standard days with >=18 shared finite, nonnegative PM and thermal hours; both means use the same hours. No imputation; reported PM zeros retained.
methods.smoother: Local linear LOESS, tricube distance weights, span 0.65; 0.50 and 0.80 sensitivity. No robust residual downweighting. Display only observed x 10th–90th percentiles, 41 grid points. Descriptive curves; no confidence bands.
methods.seasons: Winter Jan–Feb and Dec; spring Mar–May; summer Jun–Aug; autumn Sep–Nov. Winter combines two calendar-year segments.
methods.weather: Current-day mean 10 m wind (m/s) and relative humidity (%) on shared PM/thermal hours; log(1+full-local-day precipitation in mm). Preceding-hour rainfall timestamps correctly cover start+1h through end. Weather controls are linear terms.
methods.models: All models use identical days with valid current and previous three calendar-day thermal/PM pairs. MonthOnly: month intercepts + current thermal. WeatherAdjusted adds current wind/RH/log1p(rain). DistributedLag replaces current thermal with simultaneous lags 0–3. PriorPmSensitivity adds prior-day PM to DistributedLag. WeatherFormSensitivity adds squared centered wind and RH to WeatherAdjusted, retaining log1p(rain).
methods.coefficientUnits: PM2.5 micrograms/m3 per 1 degree C; cumulative is the sum of simultaneous lag0–3 coefficients, corresponding to +1 degree C on each of those four days.
methods.partialR2: Additional thermal variance explained relative to controls-only residual sum of squares on the identical sample; one thermal term for current models, four terms for distributed-lag models. Not total model R2.
methods.hac: Newey–West Bartlett HAC using actual calendar-day gaps, bandwidth 7 days, n/(n−p) finite-sample correction, normal 1.96 intervals; bandwidths 3 and 14 retained as sensitivity. Not independent-day intervals.
methods.vif: Variance inflation for each thermal term after month removal, conditional on other included weather/lag/PM terms.
limitations: Environmental concentration associations; no health outcomes, causal effects or health-interaction estimates.
One year, selected PM monitors and coarse ERA5 grid weather; Seoul districts share one weather grid.
UTCI assumes mean radiant temperature equals air temperature, not ERA5-HEAT; conditioning on wind/RH holds components of UTCI fixed.
Lagged thermal predictors are correlated; individual lag coefficients can be unstable. The cumulative coefficient is a model contrast, not a health risk.
HAC addresses coefficient uncertainty under serial dependence, not omitted-variable bias or exposure error; residual autocorrelation may remain.
Pyeongtaek reported zeros remain retained. Check selected-year monthly coverage before interpreting seasonal curves.
PM hour-start/end conventions are not uniformly documented. Reported timestamps are retained; rainfall has explicit preceding-hour intervals.
Spans, controls, lags and HAC bandwidths were fixed for this descriptive follow-up; exploratory estimates are not confirmatory inference.
